method: Whole conftest.py/utils.py read; Git blob verification. Tests not executed.
findings: Binary selected as cwd/rmlint at import time; execution cwd becomes isolated per-test directory. Exact pinned binary must be built and hashed before claiming original-suite validation.

Fixtures provision per-test temporary paths and verify RM_TS_DIR ancestry. Reflink tests require compiled btrfs support plus filesystem name btrfs/xfs/ocfs2; APFS capability is not admitted by this helper.
Xattr helper probes user.rmlint_probe even though reviewed Apple production namespace is io.github.sahib.; probe tests a generic attribute rather than exact production naming.
CKSUM_TYPES contains explicit supported families so reviewed streaming family selections are nonempty for this inventory; SSE CRC families conditional on x86_64 sse4_2.

run_rmlint_once tokenises every argument with shlex.split, including strings described as pre-split entries. Literal whitespace/quotes in path arguments require deliberate quoting and cannot be assumed covered by basic tests.
Default timeout None; process environment replaced with helper-provided map, usually empty, rather than inherited. Test runtime portability differs from ordinary shell invocation.

Pedantic JSON comparison maps paths into dicts and iterates only first document paths; duplicate records collapse, second-only records not explicitly rejected except any footer effect. For unique_file pairs all listed fields are skipped. Thus it is not complete independent output equivalence proof.
mtime fixture invokes touch -m -d and ignores exit code, so requested timestamps require verification on non-GNU environments.
limits: No upstream suite execution, no own-library edits or new tests.
Native pHash deferred; global full repository count150/500.
